data.content_ref: inline:SRC_009 (claim $1,269) REDUCES TO the causal mechanism of SRC_012/SRC_007 by a uniform-rate transformation: instead of two pay bands (base for 40h, premium for 7h), it applies the single premium rate to all 47h ($47×$27). The relation reduces the piecewise two-band calculation to a single-band uniform calculation. REFUTED IF: the $1,269 calculation cannot be described as a simplification or reduction of the standard piecewise mechanism, or if it requires inputs not present in the standard problem.
